I brought Shannon Jean back and we went shopping through live liquidation and government auctions looking for deals you could actually make money on. We broke down everything from $800 toilets selling for $50 each and Target inventory at a fraction of retail, to patio furniture, pressure washers, electric buses, ambulances, and even airplanes. Shannon explains why boring products often have less competition, how to know what you can sell something for before bidding, and how people are turning small flips into real businesses.
